limitations: st_blocks*512 is allocated-file accounting, not guaranteed freed APFS physical bytes; hardlinks/clones/snapshots may share allocation.

Qualification/benchmark original cleanup is not admitted by this inventory; exact original-map/current-byte/physical-owner proof is still required.
